A: Supplementary Table 1. Statistical data of phenotypes of drought resistance at both seedling and flowering stages for 53 maize germplasms.

Note: aThe average plant height of WS1 and WS2. 
bThe average ASI of WS1 and WS2.
cThe average yield per plant of WS1 and WS2.
